# Webware ACL Memory

Tagline: Refactor plan lives at plan/refactor-webware-acl-1.md; TASK-003 (characterization tests) is substantially underway; 100% line AND mutation coverage is the gate.

## Session handoff (2026-08-24)

- Plan file: `plan/refactor-webware-acl-1.md`. TASK-001 and TASK-002 are DONE. TASK-003 (characterization/safety-net tests per Section 6) is COMPLETE — unit suite green at 230 tests / 431 assertions; integration suite green at 11 tests / 58 assertions (0 skips).
- TASK-003 done so far: root classes (Acl, AssertionManager, ConfigProvider, RouteProvider, GrantMode, RuleType, Privilege), entities+repos (Role, Rule, Schema, RoleRepository, RuleRepository), containers (AclFactory, AssertionManagerFactory, Configuration, MessageHandlerMiddlewareFactory, RouteProviderFactory; CommandHandlerMiddlewareFactory is DEAD — refs nonexistent Webware\Acl\CommandBus\Middleware\CommandHandlerMiddleware), http-boundary (RouteResource, RouteResourceFactory, RouteResourceFactoryFactory), Admin commands (5) + handlers (5), root Middleware (AclMiddleware, AuthorizationMiddleware), root RequestHandler (ForbiddenHandler), Admin RequestHandlers (all 6), Admin Middleware (OverviewMiddleware, ProcessRoleMiddleware, ProcessRuleMiddleware).
- TASK-003 remaining: NONE for test authoring. All ~20 Container\* factories, tests-misc (Assertion\*, Exception\*, MessageBus\CommandResult\CommandStatus, Role\SingleRoleUserProxy\UserRoleIterator, Validator\*), and the 7 formerly-skipped integration tests are written and green. Only the coverage gate remains: run `composer test-coverage` + `composer mutation-test` and close any residual gaps.
- Shared test helper added: `test/unit/Support/PhpDbAdapterMock.php` (trait) — builds a PhpDb adapter mock, records SQL subjects, queues per-statement results, supports affected-rows / last-generated-value overrides and a throw-on-createStatement option. Reuse it for any DB-touching test.
- Shared integration helper: `test/integration/Support/FilterManagerFactory.php` — builds a real Laminas `InputFilterPluginManager` wired with `RoleDataFilter`/`RuleDataFilter` factories, the laminas-validator dependency config (so `ValidatorChainFactory` resolves), `AssertionManager`, and the `Assertion` validator registered via `setFactory` (NOT `setService` — `ValidatorChain::build()` with options bypasses shared services and needs a factory). Reuse for any real input-filter test.
- Test execution: unit tests run in the container (`docker compose exec -T tooling composer test`); host PHP is 8.4.0 but PHPUnit 13 needs >= 8.4.1, so NEVER run phpunit on the host. `docker compose exec -T tooling php vendor/bin/phpunit ...` works for targeted runs (the bare `vendor/bin/phpunit` exec fails on shebang).
- The `webware-coding-standard` skill was DELETED — mago now enforces style (use `mago lint --fix`, `mago format`). Do not manually apply the old coding-standard rules.
- Coverage gate (user directive): 100% line coverage AND 100% mutation coverage. All 12 formerly-skipped tests (5 unit, 7 integration, "Blocked on MessageBus query/command refactor") are un-skipped/replaced (CON-009 superseded) and green.
- Coverage baseline (measured 2026-08-25, `composer test-coverage`): **98.76% lines (1198/1213)**, 94.80% classes (73/77), 97.09% methods (167/172). ALL remaining 15 lines are blocked (dead code or bug-tied) — no more closable gaps:
  - Dead code (11 lines): `Role\SingleRoleUserProxy::$id` set hook (lines 19-23 — `private(set)` and never assigned internally, so unreachable); `Container\CommandHandlerMiddlewareFactory` (lines 23,25-27 — references nonexistent `Webware\Acl\CommandBus\Middleware\CommandHandlerMiddleware`); `Admin\Middleware\OverviewMiddleware` lines 90 (null/empty route-name skip — `Route::getName()` always returns a non-empty string) and 238 (flat branch of `normalizeRouteList()` — the allow/deny maps are always associative).
  - Bug-tied (5 lines): `Validator\Assertion::isValid()` lines 66,73,84,89 — the `return false` statements after `$this->error(...)`, unreachable until issue #15 is fixed; `Entity\Rule::resolveType()` line 69 — the string branch, unreachable until issue #17 is fixed.
  - To reach 100% line coverage, a decision is needed: remove/exclude the dead code (11 lines) and fix #15 + #17 (5 lines) — or exclude those lines from coverage via `@codeCoverageIgnore`/phpunit `<exclude>`.
  - NOTE: coverage must NOT be tied to integration tests (user directive). `RoleDataFilter`/`RuleDataFilter` now have dedicated unit tests via `test/unit/Support/InputFilterHelper.php` (real Laminas wiring); `RegisterWidgetListener` + `Widget` also have unit tests. All are 100% covered now.
  - `AccessDeniedException` (issue #14) and `InvalidConfigException` have 0 executable lines (no line-coverage impact; `AccessDeniedException` can't even be `#[CoversClass]`'d due to the fatal).
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #13): `RuleRepository::findByRoleAndResource()` calls `json_decode($row['assertions'], true)` with no null guard → TypeError on NULL assertions column under strict_types. `fetchAll()` guards correctly. Fix post-refactor per CON-001.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #14): `Exception\AccessDeniedException` extends `Exception\RuntimeException` but `RuntimeException` is `final` → fatal "cannot extend final class" on autoload. Fix post-refactor (drop `final` or implement `ExceptionInterface` directly).
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #15): `Validator\Assertion` declares `$missingAssertion`/`$invalidType` as `private`, but Laminas `messageVariables` reads them from the `AbstractValidator` parent scope → every `error()` throws `Error`; the validator can never return false. Fix: make them `protected`.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #16): `Validator\Assertion::__construct` reads `$options['nullable']` with no null guard → TypeError on null/partial options.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #18): `InputFilter\RuleDataFilter` adds `type` with only a `Filter\ToEnum` (no validator); `ToEnum` is case-sensitive and returns unrecognized values unchanged, so any non-`'Allow'`/`'Deny'` value passes `isValid()` and then TypeErrors in `SaveRuleCommand`/`UpdateRuleTypeCommand`. Production templates submit correct case, so this is input-robustness only; the old ui-mockup used lowercase. Fix post-refactor (add enum validator and/or case-insensitive mapping).
- LATENT (now issue #17): `Entity\Rule` constructor promotes `RuleType $type` (not `string|RuleType`), so `populate(['type' => 'Deny'])` would TypeError; the `resolveType()` string branch is effectively unreachable. Note it, don't fix (CON-001).
- RISK-007: ProcessRuleMiddleware (processPatch/processDelete CommandResult issues) + RuleFilter readonly-assignment bugs may be stale tracking. Move classes INTACT (CON-001); characterization tests confirm whether the bugs persist; fixes land in a separate, clearly-marked post-refactor effort.
- RISK-003: boundary violations to fix in Phase 3: AddRoleModalHandler, EditRoleModalHandler, RoleListHandler read RoleRepository directly; OverviewMiddleware reads RuleRepository directly.
- RISK-004/RISK-006 (decided): acl-local MessageBus classes stay in place but get UNWIRED from getBusConfig() (plus factory wiring removal); ALL reads go through the bus, including Acl::load() — no DI cycle while the ACL-enforcing middleware is unwired.
- Phase 2 namespace map (TASK-005, decided): `Admin\Middleware\*` → `Http\Admin\Middleware\*`; `Admin\RequestHandler\*` → `Http\Admin\RequestHandlers\*`; root `Middleware\*` (AclMiddleware, AuthorizationMiddleware) → `Http\Middleware\*`; `RequestHandler\ForbiddenHandler` → `Http\RequestHandlers\*`. Class names unchanged; no BC aliases; every move tracked in IMS issue #30. `Http\RouteResource*` stays under `Http\`; `Admin\Dashboard\*` stays (TASK-007 resolved).
- acl entities (`Role`, `Rule`) now use the PhpDb `RowPrototypeInterface`/`RowPrototypeResultSet` contract (usermanager-aligned); `RoleRepository`/`RuleRepository` hydrate via `RowPrototypeResultSet`. `SingleRoleUserProxy` updated for the new usermanager `UserInterface` (throws-only methods return `never` with `@throws Exception`). Legacy `withRowData()` proxies kept on the entities.
- acl composer.json no longer requires webware/webware-resultset; the VCS repository entry was removed and composer.lock refreshed (resolved usermanager 0.1.x-dev 29d8fcd).
- usermanager alignment work is committed/pushed (per user); acl's lock has picked it up.
- Validation commands (acl container): `docker compose exec -T tooling composer test`, `composer test-integration`, `composer mutation-test`; mago on host (see global mago memory).
- Deps: webware/message-bus ^2.0.0-beta.1 (query bus + MessageHandlerMiddleware); webware-admin 0.1.x-dev locked 468e8b4; webware-tools provides shared mago.toml guard rules. Check `Webware\Admin\Widget\WidgetInterface` imports — FQCN moved to `Webware\Admin\WidgetInterface`.
